name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1895: The vault job was in memory only, so he sweeps his vault, closes the console, and the proposal is gone while the reads that paid for it are spent. The chronicle solved this for the same reason versions ago. It persists now with the same atomic write and the same refusal to stringify what will not serialise, proven end to end in an isolated tree with his own confirmed untouched. The age ships in the same breath because a proposal that outlives the session must say how old it is, and the new live file joined the gate watchlist and the ignore file on day one, since new live state that nothing watches is exactly how the last three leaks survived.
